posts.title: Warhammer 40K: Warpforge Returns! Thanks to the Community
posts.description: This is great news! The community is reviving the Warpforge CCG. Basically, you install the Steam version as you'd normally do. Then you install MelonLoader to mod the game. You copy the WF-Revival mod inside Melon's MODS folders. And you're good to go. Launch the game, create an account and voilà!
